entry: OrbitStage3D.init(target, options)  // target = the stage container el or selector (default '#orbit-stage'); the engine builds the renderer canvas into .orbit__stage and wires every [data-state] / [data-knob] / [data-bg] in the panel. options all optional.
base: orbit3d-quadro (owner-approved working viewer) — apps/quadro/public/slide-lab/orbit3d-quadro.html · frozen pin-doc apps/quadro/public/3d/README-3D-STATE.md
rules: AN INTERACTIVE 3D ORBIT STAGE: LEFT ~70% = a live 3D scene ORBITED with the mouse (a house model); RIGHT ~30% = a TUNING panel that changes the scene in real time; a signature floating STATE TOGGLE swaps two model states with ZERO house-jump
WebGL IS ALLOWED for this isolated 3D section — it OVERRIDES the plugin's usual no-WebGL rule BECAUSE it is a self-contained 3D stage, not page chrome
the two glb states are IDENTICALLY ALIGNED (same X/Y, same Z-min; only the toggled feature differs) so the toggle never makes the house jump; the second state lazy-loads on the first toggle
engine: three 0.169 (importmap/unpkg) + GLTFLoader + DRACOLoader (the glb are Draco) + OrbitControls + procedural Sky (IBL only, no external HDR)

renderer: ACESFilmic tone-mapping, outputColorSpace SRGB, soft PCF shadows, pixelRatio min(devicePixelRatio,2); RENDER-ON-DEMAND — the rAF loop only draws on change / orbit / autorotate, so idle = 0 GPU = smooth

FIXED natural DAYLIGHT (day/night was tried and REMOVED as unrealistic): sun DirectionalLight (70,120,50) #fff4e6 intensity 2.4, Hemisphere 0.45, scene.environmentIntensity 1.0, toneMappingExposure 1.0, FogExp2 #cfdae8 density 0.00055, soft blue vertical-gradient background (#6f93c4 -> #cfdbe8)

camera PerspectiveCamera fov 42, far 20000; orbit damping 0.08, minDist 14, maxDist 320, maxPolarAngle ~0.49 pi (never under the ground); frameModel centers on X/Z, base at y=0, pulls back to ~0.9*max(size.x,size.z)
LAZY PLACEHOLDER: if a glb is missing show a stand-in box so the viewer still proves out
NO backdrop-filter / mask-composite / mix-blend over the moving 3D canvas; transform / opacity / clip only on the chrome

ACCEPTANCE = a GL-READINESS PROBE (window.__LAB_OK__ true once renderer + at least one model/placeholder is up) NOT the DOM pixel-audit gate; MUST be eye-checked in a REAL browser (headless WebGL/swiftshader is slow + unreliable). library-verify SKIPS this lab (webgl:true -> status:candidate)

models.meaning: the two glb states {stateA:url, stateB:url}; identically aligned so the toggle never jumps; stateB lazy-loads on the first toggle

toggleLabels.meaning: the floating pill labels for each state (UA copy)

dracoPath.meaning: DRACOLoader decoder path (the glb are Draco-compressed)

sunPos.meaning: DirectionalLight sun position — a high midday sun

fogColor.meaning: FogExp2 color (soft haze that fades the far yard)

fov.meaning: PerspectiveCamera field of view (the ПОЛЕ ЗОРУ knob)

far.meaning: camera far plane (so the Sky/gradient fills)

maxPolarAngle.meaning: OrbitControls max polar angle — never tilt under the ground

framePullback.meaning: frameModel pull-back factor — camera distance ~ this * max(size.x,size.z)

autoRotate.meaning: OrbitControls auto-rotate (the АВТО-ОБЕРТАННЯ toggle); forced off under reduced-motion

autoRotateSpeed.meaning: auto-rotate speed (the ШВИДКІСТЬ knob; UI value * 1.4)

ground.meaning: show the shadow-catcher ground plane (the ПЛОЩИНА toggle)
